description: This file defines the ViewAssignClaimController class within the OrangeHRM project, responsible for handling the view logic related to assigning claims in the HRM system. It extends an abstract controller and utilizes traits and components to render a Vue.js component with employee information.

classes.name: ViewAssignClaimController
classes.description: Controller class for handling the assignment of claims, responsible for preparing and rendering the Vue.js component with employee claim information.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering by setting it with employee number obtained via auth user.
